_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Siz Klondike Solitaire o'ynayapsiz. Sizning maqsadingiz barcha kartalarni asosiy stullarga ko'chirish.

O'yin qoidalari:
- Asosiy stullar (F1-F4): Turlari bo'yicha Ace dan King gacha ortib borish
- Jadvallar (T1-T7): Qizil va qora ranglarni almashlab, pasayib borish
- Zaxira: Kartalarni chiqindilar stulliga chiqarish
- Chiqindilar (W): Eng yuqori kartadan foydalanish mumkin

Buyruqlar:
- 'draw' - Zaxiradan chiqindilarga kartalarni chiqarish
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Kartalarni stullar orasida ko'chirish
  Misollar: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. Hisob 'all' ga ham bo'lishi mumkin, buning natijasida barcha ochiq kartalar ko'chiriladi.
- 'forfeit' - O'yinni darhol to'xtatish va hozirgi ballni qayd etish
- Stullar nomlari: W (chiqindilar), F1-F4 (asosiy), T1-T7 (jadvallar)

Siz bir muddatda bir nechta harakatlarni bajarish uchun ularni vergul bilan ajratishingiz mumkin:
  Misol: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Faqat Qirollar bo'sh jadvallar ustiga qo'yilishi mumkin.
Harakatlar ketma-ket bajariladi - agar bittasi muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lsa, qolgan harakatlar bekor qilinadi.
Agar o'yin g'alaba qilib bo'lmaydi deb o'ylaysiz, 'forfeit' buyrug'idan foydalaning.
